decisions.reason: As the modular continuation of a previously well-liked screen and still part of the portfolio by 2022, it appears to have validated its value, so the option is worth exercising through continued support rather than abandoning.

A multi-model mobile shredder line that has remained on the market for several years fits the firm's core mobile machinery business, and its continued presence suggests enough market acceptance to keep learning and selling rather than exit now.

The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder line is somewhat less central than the mobile range but its survival to 2022 indicates credible demand, so management would keep it while accepting a moderate chance of later portfolio pruning.
